premise_families.statement: Door opens, person at door is a power figure, lab, model or system. Quick setup, perfect reveal jokes.
A child behaves exactly like an AI agent; the costume is the alibi. Detective/narrative structure.
Halloween is fake identity night: real things get labelled synthetic, synthetic things pass inspection.
A haunted house is a controlled fear environment with measurable outcomes: an optimization target.
Halloween is one big loot event; AI solves the loot too hard.
Classic monsters displaced by automation, same engine as elf displacement.
The Halloween card itself is visibly written in AI-slop language.
Halloween has rules (one per child); agents interpret rules as adversarial specifications.
